# `gcp.logscope`

Describes a group of resources to read log entries from

[logging](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | logging |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `logging.googleapis.com/LogScope` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: encoder (encoders/logging_log_scope.go.tmpl) only derives Terraform's parent, location and short name from a full resource name, and returns the body unchanged. Here the id is logScopeId and the scope comes from the instance and create bindings.
